acceptanceCriteria: One immutable candidate freezes features and every Core wire profile.

A candidate-bound stable-readiness record replaces the alpha-only checklist semantics, supplies every required public-release identity and digest, and is captured before any tag or publication.
Every NOT_RUN is executed, removed from 1.0 scope by accepted decision, or leaves its surface non-Core.
